aka: A People’s Radio - Ballads from a Wooded Country
trans_title: A People’s Radio - Ballads from a Wooded Country
introduction: A short documentary based on a legendary Finnish radio program "Kansanradio" where ordinary people can share their worries, sorrows and joys. Soundscape of the film comes from the radio program and the film material has been shot during a road trip across Finland. An intense dialog is created between the phone calls and the landscapes showing what Finland really looks like. The tone of the film is funny and anarchic but at the same time warm and heartbreaking.
